reviewer: Codex independent UI visual review unit
review_type: AI-assisted screenshot review; not named human member cross-review

nonblocking_findings.summary: 长名称/最大金额边界夹具使商品列表末列偏窄，操作中文字换行。
nonblocking_findings.detail: 1366和1920视口均使用同一1120px内容容器。测试行的120字符名称及最大金额占据较宽列，库存、状态、排序和操作列变窄；编辑、上下架中文字换行，但内容仍完整可辨，未看到覆盖或页面水平溢出。
nonblocking_findings.decision: 按root确认保留受测93f3c461源码；作为后续列表列宽/密度优化记录，不以该观察推翻本次功能验收，也不宣称完全无排版差异。

scope: A03/A04/A05 normal and field/conflict states plus existing public reads in two desktop viewports
independently_verified_file_integrity: All 28 PNG SHA256 values and dimensions equal browser result.json; viewport widths equal PNG widths.
boundaries: Still images prove visible labels, controls, messages, field echoes and layout only; a visible readonly label does not alone prove the DOM readonly attribute or tamper resistance.
HTTP statuses are copied from original browser result.json, not inferred from image text.
Per-form CSRF field presence is recorded DOM metadata; hidden token values are neither read nor included, and token validation/zero writes require HTTP/SQL evidence.
No-op version retention, optimistic locking, restock increment, transaction isolation, actor-first locks and zero writes on refusal require the separate HTTP/SQL/native-probe acceptance records.
Description <script> text is visibly plain text; screenshots alone cannot prove no JavaScript executed.
Full-page PNG heights may exceed viewport heights and do not represent a viewport-size error.
This review does not replace pending named human cross-review before M3, and does not combine failed earlier attempts into current PASS.
